text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day, and for some
reason,
Vodka is running toward me with
blood gushing
out of her nose!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Man, I'm dizzy... I'm comin' in, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hurriedly wipes off the blood.
Everything
seems to be fine...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whew. That was rough...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, right! Why would I do that on
Valentine's
Day?
choice_data_list: Did you get into a brawl?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I got a bunch, but I'm not gonna eat 'em.
I
appreciate the thought, but I'll give
'em to
someone who wants them later.
choice_data_list: Then did you eat too much chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... I did it! I made some homemade

chocolate for Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see the look on their face.
Maybe
Trainer'll be all like, "These are
incredible!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And I'll go, "Gimme a break! They're not that good! Don't go soft on me now!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to thank me or nothin'...
They're
just to pay you back for
everything... you've done
for me... Urk!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Bwooosh!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A-actually, yeah, it was from a fight! It
was your
everyday fight to the death!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I know. I won't do it again! And don't
worry, the
other person's just fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Quite the "fight to the death"... I don't
really get
it, but I'm glad there aren't
any serious injuries.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So, anyway, I made this chocolate for
you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Give it a try. It came out a little rough
and on the
dark side... Just like me, I
guess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I open the box to find a number of cute
little dark
chocolates inside.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Th-this isn't really my thing. Guess you
could say
I'm not that used to it...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up and eat them already! You
don't gotta
stare at it. Or me...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-is it a little hot in here, or is it just
m—oh no!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Bwooosh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A red stream bursts from her nose once
more,
plunging my office into chaos.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chocolates were delicious, but talk
about a
bloody valentine...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chocolates were delicious, but talk
about a
bloody valentine...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry for makin' ya walk me home.
Pretty lame,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I mean, getting all anemic and
lightheaded from a
nosebleed? At least
no one saw me, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Fan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Vodka! Vodkaaa!

text_block_list.name: Fan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I made you some chocolates, Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? I'm surrounded!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having found their target, a bunch of

Umamusume quickly surround Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I have to get her through this
crowd
and safely back to the dorm!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What should I do, Trainer? Usually I'd
have no
trouble shakin' 'em, but in this
condition...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
More chocolate? I have a couple of
pieces that
weren't nice enough to put in
the box.
choice_data_list: Do you still have that chocolate from earlier?!
Do you still have that chocolate from earlier?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Throw them?! Oh, I get it! All right, here
goes
nothin'...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's raining chocolate! Get some while
you can!

text_block_list.name: Fan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ahhh! Chocolate from Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Fan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I want some! I want sooome! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's attention turns to the
chocolate,
giving the two of us an
opening.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
N-nice one, Trainer! There's a path
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You really saved my bacon. Kinda
reminds me
what I saw in you back
when—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
S-scratch that! Let's just hurry and get
outta here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We break straight through the gap in
the crowd! I
feel like I've been able to
repay Vodka for the
chocolate, if only a
little bit.
